scope: Source reachability against public master and published SDK; synthetic package calls are not browser or live deployment reproduction.

findings.summary: Ordinary Earn withdrawal bypasses the defective assets-to-redeem-shares path.
findings.trigger: The SDK defect requires planRedeem with an assets argument, or directly calling Earn.previewWithdraw.
findings.productionImpact: No normal Earn withdrawal over-redemption demonstrated in Lite.
findings.mitigation: Earn partial withdrawal compiles planWithdraw({assets}); max compiles planRedeem({shares}). Batch/review intentions preserve that distinction. Other previewWithdraw use is EVK-only repayment; Earn is excluded from savings repayment.
findings.reproduction: SDK fixture reproduces wrong preview at earned exchange rate, but triggering it from Lite requires changing/injecting a planner intent rather than following the normal UI.

findings.summary: SDK currentLiquidationLTV reaches Lite vault and market pair displays.
findings.trigger: A decreasing liquidation-LTV ramp at a fractional-basis-point time, or an increased target with ramp metadata.
findings.productionImpact: Vault/market collateral threshold and ramp indicators can differ from EVK; the runtime decreasing-ramp fixture gives 0.8333333333 versus 0.8333. At displayed two-decimal-percent precision this can round to the same label, so visibility depends on rounding position.
findings.mitigation: Live position risk helpers prefer accountLiquidationLTV from AccountLens over per-vault fallback. Therefore this is not proof every Lite account health metric uses the bad getter.
findings.reproduction: Load a vault/pair fixture with initial 8500, target 8000, target time 103, duration 3, timestamp 101. Inspect underlying SDK field and collateral detail; for a visible display difference choose a rounding boundary. No deployed ramp fixture established.

findings.summary: Position risk prices call the affected SDK high-decimal getter.
findings.trigger: An EVK UoA has decimals above 18 and a usable oracle price.
findings.productionImpact: The on-chain price calculation throws; affected position risk display/update can fail.
findings.mitigation: Ordinary 18-or-fewer-decimal UoAs do not trigger it. No affected deployed vault was found.
findings.reproduction: Use a 24-decimal UoA fixture in a position; getAssetUsdPrice(vault,"on-chain") reaches assetRiskPrice. Published-package runtime confirms RangeError, not browser rendering.

findings.summary: Incorrect owner-mode flags enter Lite account objects, but no UI decision consumer was found.
findings.trigger: Only secondary subaccounts discovered; owner lockdown or permit-disabled flag true.
findings.productionImpact: SDK Account state is wrong and copied into batch snapshots. An additional Lite effect from these specific wrong flags was not established.
findings.mitigation: Repository search found only copying of isLockdownMode/isPermitDisabledMode in useTxBatch, no Lite gate or flag display. Onchain enforcement remains.
findings.reproduction: Runtime adapter fixture with secondary-only discovery and both EVC flags true returns both false. Inspect Account object through the normal onchain loader; do not call it a reproduced UI bypass.

findings.summary: Known balances disappear from a fast planning snapshot.
findings.trigger: V3 returns balance rows with null optional subAccount metadata; V3-enabled fast source is used and finishes before fresh onchain or onchain fails.
findings.productionImpact: positions becomes empty. Forms/non-authoritative previews can observe incorrect planning state. This is not the normal displayed-portfolio data path.
findings.mitigation: useEulerAccount uses fresh onchain for ordinary portfolio. useFreshAccount races fast/fresh, always preferring successful fresh. Reviewed execution then hydrates required subaccounts onchain before final compilation. Hydration uses known vaults plus controller/collateral state; do not claim it discovers every missing standalone deposit.
findings.reproduction: Published-package degraded-response fixture reproduces underlying adapter defect. In local Lite intercept V3 response and delay/fail onchain account loading; inspect usePlanAccount/form preview, then release onchain and confirm replacement. No browser run performed.

findings.summary: Unknown debt becomes zero in a fast planning snapshot.
findings.trigger: V3 returns valid subAccount metadata but null borrowed/shares/assets; V3-enabled fast source is used and finishes before fresh onchain or onchain fails.
findings.productionImpact: defined Account with borrowed 0 suppresses the configured fallback. Forms/non-authoritative previews can observe incorrect planning state. This is not the normal displayed-portfolio data path.
findings.mitigation: useEulerAccount uses fresh onchain for ordinary portfolio. useFreshAccount races fast/fresh, always preferring successful fresh. Reviewed execution then hydrates required subaccounts onchain before final compilation. Hydration uses known vaults plus controller/collateral state; do not claim it discovers every missing standalone deposit.
findings.reproduction: Published-package degraded-response fixture reproduces underlying adapter defect. In local Lite intercept V3 response and delay/fail onchain account loading; inspect usePlanAccount/form preview, then release onchain and confirm replacement. No browser run performed.

findings.summary: Normal onchain portfolio discovery accepts a parseable subgraph error as empty.
findings.trigger: Subgraph/internal proxy returns JSON errors, missing data, or a parseable HTTP failure.
findings.productionImpact: Portfolio can become empty instead of showing an account-discovery failure; planners also use this discovery.
findings.mitigation: Socket errors and invalid JSON already throw. Proxy preserves upstream status/body and does not validate GraphQL success, so it does not block this mechanism. SDK creates an empty Account for unavailable discovery.
findings.reproduction: Intercept POST /api/internal/proxy/subgraph/{chainId} with 200 {"errors":[{"message":"indexing unavailable"}]} and refresh portfolio. Published-package adapter test returns {} with no rejection; browser action not executed.

findings.summary: The required bundle of more than 100 distinct owners is not generated by ordinary Lite.
findings.trigger: More than 100 matching indexed owner-prefix entities requested on same-chain SDK instance within its bundling window.
findings.productionImpact: No ordinary single-wallet/spy-account screen trigger found.
findings.mitigation: Lite account loaders each request one effective owner. Server SDK is used for vault/label reads, not mass-account discovery; separate browser tabs have separate SDK instances.
findings.reproduction: Would require a custom stress harness invoking SDK discovery for 101 owners in one instance; not a natural Lite repro.

findings.summary: Lite does not supply invalid fractional/NaN pagination configuration.
findings.trigger: Custom SDK batchSize between 0 and 1 or oracle pageSize NaN.
findings.mitigation: Browser/server builder configurations omit these settings; oracle catalogue call supplies active:true only.
findings.reproduction: Requires changing app configuration/code or directly constructing malformed SDK settings; no browser reproduction expected from normal controls.

findings.summary: First-party V3 classification uses supported canonical types.
findings.trigger: Custom API emits EulerEarn/SecuritizeCollateral aliases without recognized resource fallback.
findings.productionImpact: No current first-party Lite classification failure established.
findings.mitigation: Normal API emits earn/evk/securitize. Lite can be pointed at custom backends, making it a compatibility case.
findings.reproduction: Return an alternate alias without resource from a custom/mock V3 resolver; this changes the upstream contract versus inspected first-party producer.

findings.summary: Portfolio headline APY/ROE uses the deficient SDK aggregate; position rows use the richer getter.
findings.trigger: An eligible BORROW_COLLATERAL or LOOPING reward on a visible position.
findings.productionImpact: Portfolio headline understates rewards relative to the same position. Runtime single-position fixture shows 1% headline versus 2.5% position APY. Payouts are unchanged.
findings.mitigation: Ordinary BORROW-only rewards do not require omitted context. Live campaign eligibility/economics were not attested.
findings.reproduction: Use the committed fixture with 200 supplied, 100 borrowed, 5% supply, 8% borrow and 3% collateral-specific reward. Published 3.3.0 aggregate 1% versus position 2.5% confirmed; Lite consumes these exact getters. No browser execution.

findings.summary: Repeated population of the same Account entity was not found in Lite.
findings.trigger: Call Account.populateMarketPrices twice on same instance after price disappears/debt changes.
findings.productionImpact: The SDK defect is real, but an ordinary Lite lifecycle reaching that exact mechanism was not established.
findings.mitigation: AccountService constructs a fresh Account on each fetch. Lite replaces returned portfolio, and batch projections create new Account objects. Hydrated vault population alone is not the stale Account-field defect.
findings.reproduction: SDK same-instance fixture can reproduce; would require an added direct Account.populateMarketPrices call in Lite. Do not equate any stale display with this finding.

findings.summary: Pyth-enriched onchain account/vault reads can hide enrichment failure diagnostics.
findings.trigger: Pyth/plugin prepend attempted, then second pass absent/fails after ordinary read.
findings.productionImpact: Lite receives fallback snapshot without expected warning; price/read failure explanation is incomplete. Raw balances are not newly corrupted by this diagnostic loss.
findings.mitigation: Lite logs returned errors, so diagnostics omitted by SDK cannot be logged; read results may remain useful. Server SDK has no Pyth plugin, but browser/fresh SDK does.
findings.reproduction: Use local failing Pyth/enrichment response after a successful ordinary account/vault lens response; inspect fetched.errors. Existing SDK regression is synthetic; no browser fault injection performed.

findings.summary: Enabled Pyth plugin can encounter unsupported reverse CrossAdapter route decoding.
findings.trigger: A queried reverse CrossAdapter route contains a needed Pyth leaf and no other prefetched route supplies it.
findings.productionImpact: Read enrichment/transaction preparation can omit needed update and return deficient prices or fail.
findings.mitigation: Reverse route is valid onchain, but no actual deployed inverse/Pyth configuration was established. Ordinary forward routes do not prove trigger.
findings.reproduction: Load a reverse CrossAdapter/Pyth fixture and request vault/account read or transaction simulation. Existing SDK route regression proves missing leaf only; not a deployed browser scenario.

findings.summary: Lite fetches one chain at a time and does not call mixed-chain SDK population methods.
findings.trigger: Heterogeneous-chain array passed to EVaultService.populateCollaterals or EulerEarnService.populateStrategyVaults.
findings.productionImpact: No normal Lite cross-chain child-vault confusion demonstrated.
findings.mitigation: Browser fetches capture targetChainId; server vault snapshots/labels fetch by chain. Hydration calls each entity method with registry stub, not the faulty mixed-array service methods.
findings.reproduction: Custom SDK harness with chain 1 and 10 parents needed; switching the Lite chain alone is not this trigger.
